## 2. Security & Compliance Checklist

- [x] **Secrets Isolation**: Secrets live only in `.env.local` (never committed). Sample keys mapped in `replica/backend/.env.example`.
- [x] **Data Access Layer**: PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) enabled on all 6 tables. A user cannot delete or edit another user's videos or comments.
- [x] **Idempotency Guard**: Like actions (`video_likes`) and follow actions (`follows`) use composite primary keys. Duplicate events return clean no-ops.
- [x] **Input Validation**: Video duration constrained (`<= 300s`), captions trimmed (`<= 500 chars`), usernames regex-validated (`^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,30}$`).
- [x] **Safe Media Ingestion**: Direct-to-edge signed uploads with hard size limits (150MB). No binary payloads hit serverless function memory.
- [x] **Clean-Room Verification**: Zero calls to target app private APIs. All integrations use official documented developer APIs (Supabase, Cloudflare, Stripe).
